description: Turns increment and decrement triggers into an absolute voltage on each of sixteen polyphonic channels, adding or subtracting a fixed step on each trigger.

params.text: Sets exponential slew on the output, 0 to 5 seconds; patching the slew input takes this knob out of use.
Sets the voltage each trigger adds or subtracts, 0 to 5V.

inputs.text: Sets the slew of the output by voltage, 0-5V, in place of the SLEW knob.
A trigger adds one step to the output voltage of that channel; polyphonic.
A trigger subtracts one step from the output voltage of that channel; polyphonic.
A trigger resets the output to 0V, or to the voltage at the VOLT input when a cable is patched there; monophonic.
Sets the voltage the output is reset to; polyphonic, and normalled to its first channel.

outputs.text: The accumulated voltage for each channel, clamped to the range picked on the menu: 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V or -10V to 10V.

menu: Voltage range — 0..5V, 0..10V, -5..5V, -10..10V, or Unbounded, which applies no limit to the accumulated voltage.
